rows.scope: The declared ROV provider matrix covers pixel raw/structured/typed buffers, typed 2D and 2D-array uint/float textures, D32 depth and D24S8 stencil-enabled three-overlap passes, and exact lowering/PSO rejection for vertex, compute, and IndependentBlendEnable UAV side-effect use. Resource shapes outside this matrix remain fail-closed.
This row is closed by the declared ROV provider matrix in rasterizer-ordered-byte-address-buffer; shapes outside that matrix remain fail-closed.

The advertised tier is the verified vertex reference-model provider: six exact 8x8 R8G8B8A8 cases covering clipped/partially covered triangles, reversed winding, viewport offset, scissor clipping, a D32 depth attachment, and a degenerate triangle. The CPU reference and readback agree at 176 red pixels. Descriptor combinations outside the provider (including line, MSAA, VRS, and array interactions) remain fail-closed rather than silently approximated.
The advertised tier-1 provider is the exact four-pixel/four-sample programmable pattern and resolve matrix. Unsupported sample counts or patterns fail closed; no broader behavior is advertised.

The advertised tier-1 provider is the exact two-view pipeline-stream instancing, validated viewport/render-target array locations, and SetViewInstanceMask matrix. Unsupported view counts/layouts fail closed.

The advertised barycentric provider is the exact default-perspective SV_Barycentrics center sample. Noperspective, centroid, sample, and additional inputs remain fail-closed/outside the advertised provider.

The typed provider executes the declared native16 arithmetic and math cases through Metal half operations. The Options4 report promotes only native16; 64-KB MSAA texture alignment remains fail-closed.

The compute semantic probe passes all declared binary64 arithmetic, IEEE-754 edge, comparison, conversion, unary, predicate, and FMA cases. This is emulation, not native Metal double ALU, and the public report is tied to this provider.

Two R8G8B8A8 render targets with IndependentBlendEnable and a D32 depth attachment with depth writes enabled. Target 0 applies XOR and target 1 applies AND to distinct initialized values; replay binds one Metal global logic operation at a time while masking the other attachments, then performs one state-only depth replay. A separate UAV-writing pixel PSO is rejected before replay because repeated draws would duplicate those effects.

The GraphicsCommandList9 topology lane lowers unindexed and upload/GPU-readable indexed triangle fans, and dynamic 0xffffffff strip-cut segments, to explicit triangle-list indices. Non-readable or malformed index ranges remain fail-closed.
A depth-enabled one-pixel triangle proves the command-recorded dynamic bias changes an equal-depth LESS test to a passing fragment. Non-finite command values are rejected.

One-pixel D24_UNORM_S8_UINT stencil test with front and back triangles. Front/ref 5 and back/ref 7 are applied through the Agility 1.619.5 GraphicsCommandList8 method; the exact yellow additive readback proves both references are independently consumed. Unverified masks/operations remain fail-closed.

The VRS tier-2 report is tied to the exact advertised rate, combiner, nonconstant image, indexed, per-primitive, logical-65, and viewport-array matrices. Unsupported image shapes/rates remain fail-closed.

The declared Phase 6 graphics provider is closed by the exact graphics PSO, stencil, topology, dynamic-depth-bias, writable-MSAA, VRS, barycentric, and format/resource matrices. Geometry/stream-output, unverified interpolation/state combinations, and unsupported MSAA/raster shapes remain fail-closed rather than advertised.
